summary: Run the builder's site.yml with rm_dest, structure (role or collection), collection_org and collection_name (for collections), and model to scaffold a resource module.
questions: How do I generate a collection scaffold with the resource module builder?
What parameters does the resource module builder take?
Can the resource module builder create a role instead of a collection?

answer_card.title: Scaffold with the resource module builder
answer_card.answer_md:
Collection:
```bash
ansible-playbook -e rm_dest=<dest> -e structure=collection \
  -e collection_org=<org> -e collection_name=<name> \
  -e model=<model> site.yml
```
Role:
```bash
ansible-playbook -e rm_dest=<dest> -e structure=role -e model=<model> site.yml
```
- `rm_dest`: where generated files go
- `structure`: `role` or `collection`
- `collection_org`/`collection_name`: required for collections
- `model`: path to the model file
